subtitle: Developer Identity & Clean Release Center
changes: Added a dedicated Developer Identity page with a square crest avatar, ZevRo's independent-development profile, and NEXUS design principles.
Added an accessible Developer Identity link to desktop and mobile navigation.
Created a first-party Application Updates page that displays version history and change details without redirecting players to a code repository.
Removed development-platform wording and repository-facing links from public release screens, the user guide, onboarding, and visible account and backup descriptions.
Preserved official game-data integrations, saved builds and local media, Talent Forge, website hosting, and the established Discord release announcement workflow.
